Requirements.SystemGoal: Build a modular NLP text processing pipeline that tokenizes, removes stopwords, stems, and analyzes sentiment.

UseCase.Description: Remove common English stopwords from a list of tokens.
Reduce tokens to their root form handling double consonants.
Calculate a sentiment score (-1.0 to 1.0) based on positive/negative keywords.
Orchestrate all NLP modules into a single processing pipeline.
Provide a command-line interface to run the pipeline and output JSON.

Scope.InScope: Core NLP logic, Pipeline orchestration, CLI.
Scope.OutOfScope: Web servers, Databases, External NLP libraries (NLTK/Spacy).

Invariants.Invariant: tokenizer.tokenize(text) MUST return a list of strings.
stopwords.remove_stopwords(tokens) MUST return a list of strings.
Pipeline.process(text) MUST return a dict with keys: 'tokens', 'stems', 'sentiment'.
